feed.title: COMPASS-PSAAP
feed.subtitle: The Center for Modern Parallel Adaptive Systems Software (COMPASS), is a DOE-funded PSAAP research center focused on developing new systems software for cutting edge HPC systems.

entry.title: COMPASS 2026 Annual Review
entry.content:
Materials from the COMPASS 2026 annual review.

Download the agenda (PDF)

Presentations

  • Center Overview, Roadmap, and Y1 Milestones (Patrick Bridges)
  • Project Foundations: Training Materials, Initial Sensitivity Studies, and System Monitoring (Derek Schafer and Puri Bangalore)
  • System Optimization: Workflow, Experiment/Data Collection and Performance Tuning (Trilce Estrada and Patrick Bridges)
  • System Software Primitives: Communication Optimization (Tony Skjellum)
  • Integrated Project: Sparse Solver Performance Optimization (Amanda Bienz)
  • Integrated Project: Hydrodynamic Solver Methods (Steve Shkoller and Jason Stewart)
  • Plans for the upcoming year and beyond (Patrick Bridges)
